limitations: Original latency executables, not the instrumented adapters. File size includes symbols, embedded images and runtime; symbol/stripping policies differ.
Whole-executable text is comparable as a deployment cost. Mech native-program-only code excludes its adapter/runtime and is a separately labeled subset.
IR instruction counts are static compiler instructions, not machine instructions or dynamic retired instructions.
Stack figures are individual generated frame sizes or requested OS stack reservations; they are not measured peak call-stack use.
These are statistical current-PC observations, not CPU-time shares or dynamic instruction counts. Waiting threads can retain a wait PC while consuming no CPU.
A single odd epoch must surround each accepted register observation; sampling across a phase boundary is discarded.
JSON decoding, output verification and teardown occur outside the gate. Restored program and original JSON text are reused.
System names are resolved after sampling in the same live process; executable-local names use the exact profiled Mach-O.
